hero.title: Exemptions Information
hero.intro: Hart County property owners may qualify for certain property tax exemptions under Georgia law. Please review the information below and contact the Tax Assessor’s Office with questions about eligibility, deadlines, and required documentation.

notice.title: Important Filing Information
text: Exemptions are subject to eligibility requirements and filing deadlines established by Georgia law.
Please contact the Tax Assessor’s Office if you have questions about which exemption may apply or what documentation is needed.

process.title: Available Exemptions
process.intro: The information below provides a general overview of commonly requested exemptions.

steps.title: Homestead Exemption
steps.text: Homestead exemptions may reduce the taxable value of an owner-occupied primary residence for qualifying applicants.

steps.title: Age-Based Exemptions
steps.text: Additional exemptions may be available for qualifying senior citizens depending on age, residency, and other requirements.

steps.title: Disability and Veteran Exemptions
steps.text: Certain exemptions may be available for disabled individuals, disabled veterans, or surviving spouses when qualifications are met.

steps.title: Application Requirements
steps.text: Applicants may be required to provide identification, proof of residency, income documentation, or other supporting records depending on the exemption requested.

helpfulDetails.title: Helpful Details
helpfulDetails.intro: Things to keep in mind before applying.

blocks.title: Before you apply
items: Make sure the property is in the correct owner name.
Confirm the property is your primary residence if required.
Gather any supporting documentation before filing.
Ask the office about the filing deadline for the exemption you need.

blocks.title: Documentation may include
items: Any other records needed for the specific exemption

infoCards.title: Questions About Eligibility
infoCards.subtitle: Contact the office before filing if you are unsure.
text: Eligibility requirements can vary depending on the exemption type.
The Tax Assessor’s Office can help explain which exemption forms and supporting records may be needed.

infoCards.title: How to Apply
infoCards.subtitle: Contact the office for current forms and instructions.
text: Some exemptions require a specific application form and supporting documentation.
Please contact the Hart County Tax Assessor’s Office for the most current filing instructions.
